title: First constant cohomology vanishes on closed subschemes of the spectrum of a normal domain with separably closed fraction field (Stacks 09ZB)
statement: Let $R$ be a normal domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring] whose field of fractions is separably closed [def-pc-separably-closed], let $X=\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] and let $i:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Then for every finite abelian group $M$, with constant sheaf $\underline M$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] on $Z_{\Et}$, the etale cohomology group [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] $H^1(Z_{\Et},\underline M)$ is zero.

source.place: Lemma 09ZB (label lemma-gabber-for-h1-absolutely-algebraically-closed), line 14425, and its proof (an $H^1$ class is an $\underline M$-torsor, Cohomology on Sites Lemma 03AJ; a torsor is finite locally constant, hence represented by a finite etale surjective $V\to Z$, Lemma 03RV; $V\to Z$ has a section by Lemma 09ZA, label lemma-closed-of-affine-normal-scheme-with-alg-closed-function-field, line 14390, which uses Algebra Lemma 04D1 and Lemma 09Z9)
